structured_output.summary: In src/game.ts enterRace, swapped the order of the two calls. It now runs game.startRace({ trackId, carCount: PLAYER_CAR_COUNT }) first and playScreenChange(root, 'chequer') second, and the doc comment says why. The overlay's 330 ms removal timer used to start before the synchronous world and scene build, so a slow build could cut the chequer sweep short or remove it before it was ever painted. Now the timer only starts once startRace returns, which gives the band its full wipe. The state still changes at once and the overlay lands in the same painted frame, so AC8 behaviour is unchanged. RETRY, NEXT RACE and RACE all go through enterRace, and direct startRace calls still get no overlay. New test tests/game/chequer-after-slow-start.test.ts is the verifier's repro: a mocked createRaceScene advances fake timers by 300 ms, then the test clicks RACE, advances 250 ms and expects the chequer element to still be there. It failed before the fix and passes after. pnpm typecheck is clean and pnpm test passes (109 files, 733 tests).
